title: Carl Sagan and the Golden Disc

tellings.quote: he was the one who helped put that Golden Disc together that's now in our extra solar system

plain: Carl Sagan helped put together the Golden Disc, a gold-plated record of sounds and images from Earth sent out into space on a probe in the 1970s. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who says he ran a small Pentagon office studying unexplained aerial reports, mentions this to Michels in passing, saying the disc is now out in "our extra solar system."
